# PiTTy v0.5.17

PiTTy v0.5.17 fixes the Codex weekly-average line disappearing and makes usage history robust to multiple running instances.

## Codex Usage History

- Retention extended to a 31-day moving window, so the `avg %/day` line reflects roughly the last month instead of vanishing after a Codex reset.
- History is written atomically (temp file + rename), eliminating the partial-write corruption that previously wiped the file when several PiTTy instances ran at once.
- Each poll re-reads the latest on-disk history before recording, so concurrent PiTTy instances append to each other's samples rather than overwriting them.
- The average daily consumption line now shows as soon as a rate is available, instead of waiting for 20h of history.
